column1: # Free roam gates: openings to fly through, generated by tools/heightmap/gates.py from the nav map's doorways.
# x y z: the gate's centre at flight height; yaw: the way through (degrees, either direction);
# width: free space across on the map (m, the car's radius already off); wall: lower wall above the gate (m);
# ceiling: free height above the gate (m, inf for open sky)
